GM is a greeting used in crypto communities meaning good morning. GM is commonly posted in forums and social media as a casual opener rather than as a risk warning.

SAFU is an abbreviation for Secure Asset Fund for Users. SAFU is used as a term for a reserve fund intended to protect users.

PVP stands for player versus player. PVP describes a setting in which participants compete directly against each other.

OG is short for original gangster. OG denotes an early or long-standing member of a community.
